story.title: Fort Worth trans community space looks to build financial support
story.summary: The nonprofit had to temporarily reduce services in October due to financial constraints. This led to more than $5,000 in donations. When he came out in 2023, Nat Burton was looking for a place where he could connect with other transgender people. Shortly thereafter, he found Finn’s Place, a nonprofit located at the southeast edge of Fort Worth near the intersection of Interstate 20 and Loop 820. In that space, Burton found a community where he could be himself and others wouldn’t misgender him. “I didn’t have to explain myself,” he said. For the last two years, Burton has been board president for Finn’s Place. The organization is housed at Galileo Church and serves as a safe place for transgender and gender-diverse North Texas residents.
